Start date: Monday, 2026-06-01.

Global structure
- Lifting split: 4 days/week (Upper A, Lower A, Upper B, Lower B)
- Add-ons: 1 Plyometric/Power day; 1 HIIT day; 1–2 Zone 2 sessions; optional Threshold session
- Deload: Week 7
- Test points: Week 7 1RM test (bench, OHP; squat, deadlift over two days). Week 12 performance indicators via heavy rep work.
- RPE: Primaries mostly RPE 6–9 by phase; accessories RPE 7–9

- Supplements: Creatine 3–5 g/day; caffeine pre as tolerated; vitamin D if needed; fish oil 1–2 g EPA/DHA

PHASE 1 – Foundation and Volume (Weeks 1–3)
Goal: Groove patterns, accumulate quality hypertrophy volume, RPE 6–8.

Upper A
- Bench: Work to 1x3 @ RPE 9; Back-off 2x4 @ -10%
- Pull-Up/Pulldown 3x5–6 heavy; Incline DB 2x8; Row 2x6–8; light accessories optional

- Heavy days: +25–50 g carbs pre and post beyond baseline
- Hydration: 30–40 ml/kg/day + 500–1,000 ml on training days; include sodium
- Micronutrients: Iron adequacy, calcium ~1,000 mg, vitamin D 1,000–2,000 IU if needed, omega-3 1–2 g EPA/DHA
- Supplements: Creatine 3–5 g/day; caffeine 3–6 mg/kg pre (as tolerated)

- If two primaries in one session reach ≥RPE 9.5, drop one accessory set or reduce next session’s back-offs by 1 set
- Stop explosive sets when output drops >10%
- Use microloads (1–2.5 kg) to sustain progression on upper lifts
- Maintain bracing, depth, and bar path standards; no frequent grinders
